pictures.name: QPA1-Sand-Courtyard
pictures.prompt: A quiet courtyard in old Medina long ago in the late afternoon: smooth pale sand, palm-trunk pillars and a palm-frond roof edge in the foreground, a small straight stick lying on the sand, long gold light. Calm and expectant. No people or human figures of any kind, no hands, no silhouettes, no faces. No angels, spirits or beings of any kind in any form, not even as figures of light, glowing shapes or wings. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike, rich textiles and textures, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still. One tall 9:16 vertical picture, main subject in the middle. No text, no letters, no logos.
